# Getting help

Pick the place that matches your question.

| You want to | Go to |
| --- | --- |
| Learn the language | [The Beskid Book](https://beskid-lang.org/book/) |
| Look up how something works | [Beskid Docs](https://beskid-lang.org/docs/) |
| Know what the rules are, exactly | [The Beskid Standard](https://beskid-lang.org/docs/standard/) |
| Install the CLI | [Downloads](https://beskid-lang.org/downloads/) |
| Find or publish a package | [pckg.beskid-lang.org](https://pckg.beskid-lang.org) |
| See what ships in which version | [Tracker](https://tracker.beskid-lang.org) |
| Report a bug | [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/Cyber-Nomad-Collective/beskid/issues/new/choose) |
| Propose a feature | [Tracker](https://tracker.beskid-lang.org); behaviour changes start as an OpenSpec change |
| Report a vulnerability | [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md), privately |
| Contribute | [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) |
| Reach the maintainer | Book chapter 22, [Contact](https://beskid-lang.org/book/22-so-you-want-to-contribute/contact/) |

## Before you ask

- Check the [Book's troubleshooting page](https://beskid-lang.org/book/01-it-works-on-my-machine/troubleshooting-install/)
  for install problems.
- Include your `beskid --version`, operating system and target.
- If the Book's own example fails, the Book is wrong. Say so in a bug report.

Beskid is maintained by a small team. There is no paid support. Clear reports
with a minimal reproduction get answered first.
